data.one_liner: Offline background removal for images on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that performs offline background removal and object/person detection on images. It supports both image paths and Uint8List inputs across Android and iOS platforms.
use_when: You need to remove image backgrounds offline without using an external API.
You are building a photo editing app for Android and iOS.
You need object and person detection for background segmentation.
avoid_when: You need background removal on platforms other than Android and iOS.
You require web or desktop support.
strengths: Works completely offline without internet connection.
Supports both Android and iOS platforms.
Handles both person and object detection.
weaknesses: Limited platform support (only Android and iOS).
No web or desktop support documented.
data.setup_notes: Requires iOS 15+ and Android 4.4+ (SDK 19). Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml.
